capabilities.description: Workspace type-check, lint, tests, and production build
Isolated stable UI sync, runtime fetch, route serialization, and authentication contract groups
pi-backed agent contracts and event mapping
Single-workspace session store, restoration, tokens, todo, permission, question, and abort contracts
HTTP routes, authentication, SSE lifecycle, and explicit unknown responses
Home-confined supported file operations and sensitive-path rejection
Disposable-repository Git operations and negative cases
Real node-pty and authenticated WebSocket lifecycle
Configured, absent, disabled, and damaged local configuration behavior without network model calls
A repository-owned Playwright scenario exercises packed UI bootstrap, session creation, prompt, SSE rendering, and reload using a deterministic local agent
Pack, clean install, CLI health, auth, explicit unknown route, and restart
Local evidence binding and exact-artifact publication guard
This release supports one configured workspace per server process
No provider credential or billable network model operation is claimed by this matrix
Electron and mobile packaging are not qualified
